timeline.title: Season launch assembly
timeline.description: Introduction to STEM Racing for Years 8 to 12. Meet last season's teams and see the cars up close.

timeline.title: Proposal booklets due
timeline.description: Each team submits a short booklet covering team roles, a car concept and a sponsorship plan.

timeline.title: Team interviews
timeline.description: Teams present their proposal to Ms Puri and the student mentors. Teams are confirmed the following week.

timeline.title: Design freeze
timeline.description: CAD files are checked against the regulations before machining begins.

timeline.title: Regional Finals, New Delhi
timeline.description: First race of the season. Development and Professional classes compete for places at Nationals.

timeline.title: National Finals, Bengaluru
timeline.description: Top teams from each region. Winners earn a place at the World Finals.

timeline.title: World Finals
timeline.description: Venue and dates to be confirmed by the organisers.
